boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of San Diego
boards.description: Ten currently documented food destinations in San Diego with late-night availability and a direct official source for each location’s hours.

cards.title: Shake Shack Mission Valley
cards.subtitle: 675 Camino De La Reina, Mission Valley
cards.notes: Use the Mission Valley location when you need a documented 2 AM option; its official page lists dine-in, pickup, and delivery.
cards.short_summary: A Mission Valley counter-service stop with 2 AM hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack’s Mission Valley location lists daily hours of 10:00 AM–2:00 AM and offers dine-in, pickup, and delivery.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 10:00 AM–2:00 AM Sunday through Saturday; dine-in, pickup, and delivery are listed.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger on Camino Del Este
cards.subtitle: 2005 Camino Del Este, Mission Valley
cards.notes: Plan around the posted closing time and use either the drive-thru or dine-in seating listed on the official location page.
cards.short_summary: A Mission Valley burger stop with service documented to 1 AM or later.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out’s 2005 Camino Del Este location lists drive-thru and dine-in seating, closing at 1 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official normal hours: 10:30 AM–1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 AM–1:30 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger at Sports Arena
cards.subtitle: 3102 Sports Arena Boulevard, San Diego
cards.notes: Check the posted close before heading over; this location’s official page documents both a drive-thru and dine-in seating.
cards.short_summary: A Sports Arena-area In-N-Out with late posted closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out’s 3102 Sports Arena Boulevard location lists drive-thru and dine-in seating, with normal hours to 1 AM or 1:30 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official normal hours: 10:30 AM–1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 AM–1:30 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger in Kearny Mesa
cards.subtitle: 4375 Kearny Mesa Road, San Diego
cards.notes: This is a late-closing Kearny Mesa option; the official page confirms both seating and drive-thru availability for the location.
cards.short_summary: A Kearny Mesa In-N-Out with documented service past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out’s 4375 Kearny Mesa Road location lists drive-thru and dine-in seating, closing at 1 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official normal hours: 10:30 AM–1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday; 10:30 AM–1:30 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Denny’s on West Point Loma Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 3920 West Point Loma Boulevard, San Diego
cards.notes: Keep this round-the-clock diner in reserve for a sit-down meal or takeout; the official page identifies it as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A nearby 24-hour diner with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and takeout.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists its 3920 West Point Loma Boulevard restaurant as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Denny’s official San Diego location page identifies 3920 W. Point Loma as open 24 hours.

cards.title: Denny’s on Miramar Road
cards.subtitle: 6908 Miramar Road, San Diego
cards.notes: Choose this Miramar Road diner when the timing is uncertain; the location page confirms round-the-clock restaurant hours and walk-ins.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner with walk-ins and takeout listed by the restaurant.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists its 6908 Miramar Road restaurant as open 24 hours every day, with walk-ins and takeout available.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday; walk-ins and takeout are listed.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Eastman Street
cards.subtitle: 7049 Eastman Street, Clairemont
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the late window, since the official page separately lists earlier dine-in hours for this Clairemont location.
cards.short_summary: A Clairemont drive-thru with official 2 AM daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s 7049 Eastman Street location lists drive-thru hours of 7:00 AM–2:00 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours until 2:00 AM daily; dine-in hours are listed separately and end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Mission Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 4401 Mission Boulevard, Pacific Beach
cards.notes: For a later drive-thru option toward Pacific Beach, consult the daily schedule; dine-in service ends earlier than the drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A Mission Boulevard drive-thru documented to 3 or 4 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s 4401 Mission Boulevard location lists drive-thru service until 3 AM most nights and 4 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours: until 3:00 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 4:00 AM Thursday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Aero Drive
cards.subtitle: 9821 Aero Drive, Kearny Mesa
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru late in the evening, and check the day: the official page posts later Thursday through Saturday closing times.
cards.short_summary: An Aero Drive drive-thru with weekday and weekend late-night coverage.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s 9821 Aero Drive location lists drive-thru hours to 1:45 AM on most nights and 2:45 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours: until 1:45 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 2:45 AM Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell on El Cajon Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 4545 El Cajon Boulevard, San Diego
cards.notes: Treat this as a drive-thru run after the dining room closes; the official page gives a consistent 2 AM drive-thru schedule.
cards.short_summary: An El Cajon Boulevard drive-thru open until 2 AM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s 4545 El Cajon Boulevard location lists drive-thru hours of 7:00 AM–2:00 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru hours until 2:00 AM every day; dine-in hours are listed separately and end earlier.
